account

(noun). Lời tường thuật

(noun). chính sách

initiative

(noun). Kiến nghị, sáng kiến

government

(noun). chính phủ

Ex: She is the government official in charge of the project.

strategy

(noun). Chiến thuật

(verb). bắt đầu, bắt tay vào

(noun). sự tư vấn

(verb). xử lí, hiểu

(noun). sự cố gắng

(noun). viện

establish

(verb). Thiết lập

(noun). toán, đội, nhóm

Ex: The UN called on all parties in the conflict to take a positive stance towards the new peace initiative.

evaluate

(verb). Đánh giá

Ex: It's impossible to evaluate these results without knowing more about the research methods employed.

(noun). sự vang (âm thanh); sự phản xạ (ánh sáng, sức nóng...)

Ex: The house shook with the reverberation of the bomb.

hypothesis

(noun). Giả thuyết

Ex: There is little evidence to support these hypotheses.

researcher

(noun). Nhà nghiên cứu

Ex: Researchers found there was no evidence of an increased risk of infection.

involve

(verb). liên quan, bao hàm

Ex: The test will involve answering questions about a photograph.

collaborative

(adjective). hợp tác, cộng tác

Ex: The presentation was a collaborative effort by all the children in the class.

interaction

(noun). sự tương tác

Ex: There's not enough interaction between the management and the workers.

multiple

(adjective). nhiều

Ex: The shape appears multiple times within each painting.

individual

(adjective). cá nhân

Ex: We interviewed each individual member of the community.

possession

(noun). quyền sở hữu; sự chiếm hữu

Ex: The possession of a passport is essential for foreign travel.

amount to

(verb). có nghĩa là

Ex: Army leaders say the retreat from the area does not amount to an end to the war.

heighten

(verb). tăng thêm, tăng cường

Ex: Tension has heightened after the recent bomb attack.

demand

(noun). sự đòi hỏi, sự yêu cầu

regulation

(noun). sự quy định, sự điều khiển

imperative

(adjective). cấp bách, khẩn thiết

Ex: We consider it absolutely imperative to start work immediately.

take into account

(verb). để ý tới, lưu tâm tới

Ex: Coursework is taken into account as well as exam results.

(noun). khung cảnh

Ex: It was the perfect setting for a wonderful Christmas.

(adjective). Phù hợp

(noun). sự hào hứng, sự hăng hái

Ex: The news was greeted with a lack of enthusiasm by those at the meeting.

reputation

(noun). danh tiếng

Ex: The company enjoys an international reputation for quality of design.

supply

(verb). cung cấp

Ex: The company supplied schools with sports equipment.

accomplish

(verb). đạt được

Ex: The first part of the plan has been safely accomplished.
